note: P4366 (Pro 30:11) — there are those who curse their fathers and do not bless their mothers.

dims.v: filial impiety — the generation that curses its father and will not bless its mother
the impiety of a generation that curses its father and does not bless its mother — the contempt for parents that heads Agur's portrait of a corrupt generation, honour owed and withheld
the contempt for father and mother that marks a corrupt generation

barak (bless), negated + curse — 'there are those who curse their fathers and do not BLESS their mothers' (30:11); the first mark of a wicked generation is contempt for parents. To curse a father and withhold blessing from a mother is a foundational impiety (cf 20:20; 30:17; Ex 21:17).
